creator: Alexander Terp
description:
The owner, 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-07: a native Muster feature, not a beagle job calling `muster pane new`. Schedule a Muster agent to spawn with instructions, in a given directory. It could be a cron, but in practice it is more likely to be a one-time spawn at a set time, so support both.

Design questions:
- Who holds the schedule. The daemon, presumably, since `muster msg` already works with no window open and the app may be closed when a time arrives.
- Where the pane appears when no window is open, and how the owner finds out it started.
- A machine asleep or a daemon down at the scheduled time: run late, skip, or say so.
- Which machine it runs on, and whether a schedule set on the laptop can target a devenv.
- What a schedule names: directory, command or harness, model and effort, brief, pane name, and whether it can start as a helper.
- The surface: a CLI verb, the API, and a list with cancel, so a pending schedule can be seen and removed. Whether a schedule survives a daemon restart (it is intent, so `docs/architecture.md` allows it).
title: Schedule an agent to start later, once or on a cron, with its instructions and directory
